name: store_register_and_increment

name: return_without_action

description: Subtracts two from a byte in a structure addressed by a base register, then walks seven twelve-byte entries of the global data block, storing each entry pointer in a global variable and calling a routine for each one.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:21F66
name: iterate_table_entries
description: Walks seven twelve-byte entries of a global data block, storing each entry's pointer in a global variable and calling a routine for each one.

name: update_counter_state
description: Steps a signed 16-bit counter in a structure toward zero. A negative counter rises and resets to 150 on reaching zero; a positive counter falls and is cleared at zero, with routines called during these transitions, including one that hides a display object.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:21FF6
name: compute_stepped_position

name: compute_threshold_step_position
description: Works out a new position from a target value, a current value, a signed step and a threshold table addressed by the A0 register. name: adjust_step_against_threshold
description: Adjusts a signed step by comparing a distance with a threshold from a table indexed by a register value, then returns the adjusted step added to a base value.

name: adjust_step_from_table_entry
description: Adjusts a signed step by checking a distance against a threshold table entry, then returns the adjusted step added to a base value. It is the same comparison as the neighbouring routine without its initial direction test.

name: subtract_step_from_offset
description: Subtracts one register input from another, then adds a third register input and returns the sum.

name: combine_signed_step_with_base
description: Negates the second register input when the first is zero or positive, then returns the sum of the first input, that possibly negated second input and a third input.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2208C
name: sum_three_register_inputs
description: Returns the sum of three register inputs with no conditions.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2243E

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:224AA
name: store_constant_when_active
description: If a global variable is non-zero, it stores the constant 303 in another global; otherwise it leaves that global unchanged.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22516
name: initialize_node_table_entries
description: When a global flag is set, walks forty-six entries of a global table, calling a routine for each one, storing each entry pointer and writing zero plus two fixed constant words into the node it points to. It writes a minus-one end marker after the last entry.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22564
name: place_entry_after_bit_checks
description: Returns unless a global flag is set and no earlier work is pending. It scans a list of pointers for a free entry and checks a bit in a table up to three times; when the check passes it stores two position words into the entry and sets a global countdown to ninety.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22624
name: update_state_counter
description: When a global flag is set, it reduces a countdown by a step chosen from bit flags in another global. When the countdown drops below one it resets it to seven, advances an index that wraps after four values and calls a routine. When the flag is clear, it calls routines and resets a status word.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22740
name: store_words_in_ring_buffer
description: Stores two words from fixed global addresses into a 128-byte array at the current index, then advances the index by four and wraps it within zero to 127.

name: update_position_from_delta
description: When a global counter is non-negative, it copies a saved word and, if a pending flag is set, adds a delta computed from two stored values to a position word, clears the flag and calls routines to process the result.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:227EA
name: shift_structure_longword_fields
description: Copies two longword fields of a structure forward by eight bytes, then moves the next two longword fields into their places. The structure is addressed by the A0 register.

name: reset_state_flags
description: Clears several global state flags. A global flag and a position value tested against two thresholds decide whether some flags are cleared earlier or one extra routine is called; the routine then calls two routines to complete the reset.

name: reset_state_flags
description: Clears several global state flags. name: clamp_accumulator_and_store_state
description: Adds a global delta to an accumulator and clamps it between zero and a limit global, then stores the value and derived nibble and difference fields in a structure. It increments a change counter whenever the difference is non-zero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:228E2
name: update_scroll_position
description: Clamps a scroll offset between zero and a global limit, updates the stored difference and related flags, and wraps the resulting tile row and column values into a fixed range before storing them in the scroll structure.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22A24
name: advance_counter_and_clear_state
description: Increments a global counter, capping it at four, then clears five related global variables to zero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22A5C
name: set_flag_and_show_object
description: Sets a global flag to all ones, writes one into a field of the structure pointed to by a global pointer and one into a second field at a further offset, then calls a routine that the facts identify as show display object and returns with the data registers unchanged.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22A8A
name: fetch_word_from_masked_table
description: Reads a word from a table addressed by the A1 register, indexed by the word at the A0 register with its sign bit cleared, and returns that word.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately with no instructions, so it is an empty stub.

name: check_flags_and_call_routines
description: Checks a global flag: when it is zero it calls two routines; when it is set and a second global is zero it calls one routine and, if a third global is below one, calls another.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22AEE
name: store_shifted_combined_word
description: Calls two routines, then stores a word combined with itself shifted left by four bits into the location addressed by a pointer held in the frame structure.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22B2E
name: process_entity_state
description: When a global flag is clear and a value returned by a routine is below 253 with a pending field set, it clears that field, copies two fields into a second pair, stores one into a table slot chosen by the other, then calls routines and clears another field.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22B7A
name: adjust_position_from_flag_bits
description: When a mode value equals two, it picks a step of minus two or plus two from two bits of a global flag byte. With no step it moves a position two units back toward zero; otherwise it adds the step, records it and clamps the position to plus or minus 140.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22BDE
name: call_five_routines_in_order
description: Calls five routines in sequence and returns, with no other work between the calls.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22C14
name: clamp_sum_and_decrement
description: Adds two global values when the first is non-zero and caps the result at 303; when the first is zero the cap is applied directly. It then subtracts one from the result and calls a routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22C42
name: check_event_counter_and_dispatch
description: Decrements a global countdown while a flag is clear. When it reaches zero it resets a status word, sets a second countdown to 250 or 125 depending on a flag, and calls several routines to dispatch the event.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22CE8
name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately with no instructions, so it is an empty stub. Two routines call it.

name: check_position_distance_limits
description: When a global flag is set, it measures the absolute distances of two coordinates from fixed targets of 150 and 100 and compares them with limits of 600 and 500. key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22DEE
name: clear_global_word_table
description: Writes zero to 32 consecutive words of a global table, one after another.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22E00
name: check_and_reset_flags
description: When a global flag is zero, it calls a routine, then calls another and sets a global to two when a structure field is non-zero. When a second field is non-zero it clears that field and calls a routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22E2E
name: fill_table_pointers_and_values
description: Computes a starting address from two stored values and a global table, then fills 22 consecutive entries. Each entry waits while a status bit is set, then stores a pointer taken from the table, a value that rises by two per entry and a fixed constant.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22EA4
name: compute_offset_and_row_count
description: Computes a memory pointer from scroll values and a row offset and stores it in a global. It selects 17 or 14 depending on a flag and subtracts a row count from it, stores the offset in a structure, and calls a routine to finalize the value when the row count is non-zero before returning the packed result.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22F52
name: apply_masked_table_loop
description: Loops over the count held in the data register, reading a word from a table and stepping the table pointer by a stride. After each read it waits while a status bit is set, then stores the masked word plus a base value into one location and a fixed word into another.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22F70
name: copy_seven_words_from_entry
description: Copies seven words from a global table entry selected by the data register, where each entry is fourteen bytes, to the start of the same table.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22F8C
name: copy_table_start_to_entry
description: Copies seven words from the start of a global table into the table entry selected by the data register, where each entry is fourteen bytes.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:22FA8
name: setup_display_and_run_frames
description: Initializes several state variables, then makes a series of calls, each preceded by writes of word pairs to fixed locations. It then enters a per-frame loop that copies a display entry and calls routines in sequence, similar to the main frame loop.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:231DC
name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls one routine and returns, so it only forwards the call with no other work.

name: toggle_global_flag

name: loop_until_value_matches
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until its return value matches a value held in the data register, then calls it again until the return value no longer matches a second value held in the data register.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2321C
name: update_state_counters
description: When a global value is zero and a flag is set, a delay counter counts down first. Afterwards a counter increments, and once it is zero the routine clears a register and sets a state value to one, or to two when another flag is set.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23272
name: initialize_pointer_arrays
description: Stores the address of a global variable into several pointer locations and calls routines. Between these calls it writes word values copied from fixed locations through pointers.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23342
name: fill_structure_with_constant_pairs
description: Fills a structure with a fixed list of long-word constants, with one set chosen by a flag, then appends further constant pairs and an end marker. Routines are called between these writes.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2354A
name: wait_for_status_bit_cycle
description: Stores a fixed value into a global, waits while bit 6 of a status location is set, then waits until it is set again. The facts list the CIA port A register as touched, whose bits report fire buttons and disk status, but the code shows only the bit polling.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23576
name: fill_words_with_increments
description: Writes a running sequence of word values into a table, four words per iteration: a counter, the high half of a 32-bit value, the counter plus two, and the low half of that value. The counter rises by four and the value by a register stride each step, for a count taken from the data register.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2358E
name: call_three_routines_per_pass
description: When a global flag is zero it calls three routines once; otherwise it repeats those three calls three times.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:235CE
name: fill_word_table_by_index
description: Fills sixteen consecutive words of a global table with values equal to each index times 320, with bit zero set.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:235EE
name: fill_table_with_step
description: Writes 272 consecutive longword values into a global table, starting at zero, with each value 220 more than the one before.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23608
name: clear_flag_and_invoke_callback
description: When a flag is set, it clears the flag and calls a function pointer taken from a global table twice, once with no argument and once with a saved register value. The facts identify the table call as the Exec library call for removing an interrupt server.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23638
name: register_two_interrupt_servers
description: Clears two blocks of twenty-two bytes in global memory, then fills two interrupt server structures with the values 9 and 2 in fixed fields and a handler pointer, registering each one through the Exec AddIntServer call. The referenced names BubbleCop and BubbleVB are probably the two server names.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2370A
name: update_loop_counters_and_wait
description: Sets a global byte to all ones, sets a bit in one counter, increments two counters, then waits until the byte rises to at least five, calling routines during the wait. The facts list the vertical beam position register as touched, but the code shows no direct access to it.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23772
name: update_global_flags
description: Sets one global byte to all ones, sets a bit in a second global and increments a third global.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23788
name: clear_flag_and_call_callback
description: When a flag is non-zero, it clears the flag and calls a function pointer from a global table. The facts identify the table call as the Exec library call for removing an interrupt server.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:237A6
name: add_priority_interrupt_server
description: Calls one routine, clears a field of a server structure, sets its priority to 127 and its type to two, points it at a global block and sets its handler to another routine, then registers it through the Exec AddIntServer call. The referenced text BubbleKeys suggests keyboard input.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23802
name: set_flag_bit_and_call
description: Sets bit zero of one global, clears another global, then calls two routines in sequence and returns the data register unchanged. The facts list the keyboard serial register as touched, but the code does not show that access directly.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2382E
name: set_or_clear_bitmap_bit
description: Sets or clears one bit in a byte-addressed bitmap. The byte is chosen from the upper bits of the input and the bit from bits one to three; the bit is set when the lowest input bit is zero and cleared otherwise.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2384C
name: clear_bit_at_offset
description: Clears one bit, selected by the low three bits of the D2 register, in the byte at an offset from the A0 base given by the D1 register.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23852
name: lookup_key_character
description: Clears a global byte, then for an even input value loads the byte at an index of half that value from a table starting at the global block. The referenced text is a keyboard character layout string, which indicates the table maps key codes to characters.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23880
name: initialize_game_parameters
description: Runs a fixed sequence of initialization calls, choosing between two calls by a flag. It then calls a routine with four arguments in two loops, one running three times with indexes starting at four and one running seven times with indexes starting at twenty, and finishes with four more calls.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23A44
name: initialize_sequence_table
description: Writes seven six-word entries into a global table. Each entry holds an incrementing value starting at twenty, followed by five zero words.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23A72
name: write_incrementing_sequence
description: Writes three seven-word entries into a global table. Each entry begins with an incrementing value starting at four, followed by six zero words.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23AA4
name: read_shifted_masked_longword
description: Reads a longword at offset four from the A6 base, shifts it right by eight bits, applies a mask that keeps bits zero to eight and sixteen to thirty-one, and returns the result.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23AB0
name: call_routines_and_clear_flag
description: Calls two routines, calls a third when a global flag is zero, calls one more routine, and then clears a second global flag to zero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23AEE
name: swap_pointers_and_copy_value
description: Swaps two global pointer variables, then copies the longword at offset four from the old first pointer into a field of the frame structure.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23B0E
name: swap_two_globals
description: Exchanges the values of two global longwords.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23B28
name: update_timer_counters
description: When a global flag is clear, it decrements a non-zero countdown and subtracts a step from a value when that countdown is negative or has just run out. When a second countdown is non-zero it adds one to a value and decrements that countdown, then calls five routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23BF4
name: call_routines_then_clear_globals
description: Calls a routine, then four more when a global flag is zero, then calls two further routines and clears two globals to zero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23C6E
name: advance_state_then_run_frames
description: Adjusts pending step counters and a state value, then either returns early or sets state fields and makes a series of calls that write fixed word pairs to locations before entering the per-frame loop that copies a display entry and calls routines in order.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23CC0
name: advance_pending_step_counter
description: When a pending flag is set, it either raises a ready flag directly or, when another flag is set, increments a step counter and raises the ready flag when the counter reaches three, resetting it to two. It then sets a state value to five and calls two routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23CFC
name: set_ready_state_and_call
description: Sets a ready flag, clears a pending flag, sets a state value to five and calls two routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23D16
name: setup_frame_states_and_loop
description: Makes a series of calls, each preceded by writes of fixed word pairs to locations, and then runs the per-frame loop that copies a display entry and calls routines in order, with some calls chosen by flags.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23D32
name: run_frame_loop_with_flags
description: Runs the per-frame loop, which copies a display entry each frame and makes calls chosen by global flags, writing fixed word pairs before each call.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23D74
name: branch_then_run_frame_loop
description: Branches on the sign of a global. A non-negative value calls routines and returns; otherwise it sets state fields, writes fixed word pairs, and runs the per-frame loop that copies a display entry and calls routines in order.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23D80
name: reset_state_and_call_routines
description: Calls one routine, clears a state variable, then calls three routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23DA0
name: find_table_entry_and_dispatch
description: Calls a routine, then scans a global table in sixteen-byte entries for one whose stored longword matches a global pointer value. If a flag is set, it calls a routine with that pointer, the matched entry and a computed address. The referenced text CHIPSAMS.BIN is a file name, the only clue to what the data holds.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23F14
name: copy_nested_longword_blocks
description: Copies longword data from a source pointer to a destination buffer in nested loops. The source pointer advances by ten longwords per step, and the outer loop moves to the next block after each pass.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23F52
name: double_byte_table
description: Walks a global byte array and writes each byte, doubled, as a word into a global word array at the same position. The number of entries comes from a global counter.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23F74
name: call_routines_if_flag_zero
description: When a memory flag is zero it calls a routine, then calls three more routines if a second global is also zero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:23FA2
name: copy_state_and_reset_fields
description: When two global flags are clear and a routine returns a non-zero check, it copies two longwords from the source structure to the destination, clears a longword in the destination, sets a global to minus one and stores ten into a field of the source.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24010
name: check_coordinate_proximity
description: Checks whether a flag bit in a byte is set, then compares two pairs of coordinates against thresholds of 25 and 6 by absolute difference. Every path returns without writing anything, so the decompiled code has no visible effect.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24040
name: update_state_coordinates
description: Calls a routine, then branches on a register value. When that value is zero and a state value is not three, it calls two routines. Otherwise, when the state is not one, it stores two coordinates derived from global values with offsets of forty and minus sixteen and sets the state to one.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:240FE
name: compute_movement_delta
description: When a flag is clear, it sets a state value to two and, unless an early distance check returns, computes a step of plus or minus 20 from the sign of a value. It writes the result with another value offset into one global and a value seven below another global into a second.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24174
name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines in order and returns.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24186
name: poll_routine_until_threshold
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until its return value plus two reaches 44, then repeats this for seventeen passes, or fourteen when a flag is set.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:241DA
name: copy_sparse_words_to_buffer
description: Copies word values from a source table at widely spaced offsets into a destination buffer at evenly spaced positions, in one long run of paired assignments.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24400
name: build_trampoline_code_block
description: Writes a short run of machine instructions into a memory buffer: it saves A0 on the stack, loads A0 with the address of a global block, calls through A0, then restores A0, with no-op padding. It also stores this routine's own address in a global variable.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24438
name: wait_until_value_reaches
description: Reads a value from a routine, then either calls a routine with that value plus four or, when a flag is set, masks a status word. It repeats the read until the value reaches the threshold held in the data register.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24458
name: call_then_wait_for_threshold
description: Calls one routine, then calls a second routine repeatedly until its return value reaches the threshold in the data register. It returns the stacked value it was given.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24472
name: update_control_word_from_input
description: Calls a routine picked from a global table by a mode value, then rebuilds a control word from input bits and the previous control word. When a state flag and a countdown condition hold, it counts down and sets bit fourteen, and it rewrites flag fields when another flag is set.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:244D0
name: decrement_countdown_and_store_flags
description: Decrements a countdown; when it has run out it resets it to ten and sets bit fourteen of a control word. It stores the control word, masking it to a few bits when another global flag is set.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24526
name: check_flags_without_effect
description: Tests two flags and returns in every branch, so it has no visible effect.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24542

name: check_flags_without_effect
description: Tests two flags and returns in every branch, so it has no visible effect.

name: call_routine_and_set_byte
description: When two flags meet a condition, it calls a routine and sets a global byte to seven; otherwise it returns unchanged.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24644
name: call_routine_then_set_byte
description: Calls one routine, then sets a global byte to seven and returns. The facts list the CIA port A register as touched, but the code does not access it directly.

description: Returns immediately with no instructions, so it is an empty stub.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:246C2
name: delay_then_clear_high_bit
description: Clears the top bit of a global byte, runs a short countdown loop of seven steps, clears the top bit again and then stores an all-ones value into the global.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:246EC
name: pulse_bit_in_byte
description: Repeatedly sets and then clears one bit, selected by the low three bits of a register, in a byte addressed by the A4 register, for a count taken from the data register. It then clears the top bit of a global byte and stores an all-ones value into the global.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24722
name: update_timer_counter
description: When a flag is set, it decrements a timer and, when the timer reaches zero, resets it to eight and advances a phase counter. The phase counter restarts at two after four steps, and a second flag is set at step two when it is clear, then a routine is called.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:247CA
name: compute_viewport_offsets
description: When a global flag is clear, it sets two offsets to zero, then adds or subtracts 131072 to each depending on bits of a control word. It copies and rotates a coordinate pair and checks thresholds before adjusting a delta value and calling routines. Otherwise, when a mode value is six, it adds 16384 to one offset and applies the offsets to two position values.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:248E6
name: reset_flag_then_call_two
description: Clears a global flag, then calls two routines in order and returns.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:248F6
name: clamp_offset_between_bounds
description: Computes an offset by comparing a global with a structure field, makes adjustments under flag conditions, and clamps the result between zero and 195. It stores the clamped value in a global along with a second global derived from a structure field.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:249AC
name: check_condition_and_copy_pointers
description: Calls a routine, then if a register value is non-zero calls another and, if it is still non-zero, sets a global flag to one and calls a third routine. When the register remains non-zero it copies two pointer values from one global pair to another.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24A04
name: update_position_accumulator
description: Tests eight bits of a mask derived from a global word and a register value. For each set bit it calls a routine, and it returns early if that routine's result has its top bit clear. Otherwise it adds two velocity fields to two position fields in the structure.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24A76
name: check_bit_flags_loop
description: Tests eight bits of a mask derived from a global word and a register value and calls a routine for each set bit. It returns early if a routine result has its top bit clear; otherwise it adds one structure field to another.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24AD6
name: check_bit_flags_and_update
description: Tests eight bits of a mask derived from a global word and a register value and calls a routine for each set bit. It returns early if a routine result has its top bit clear; otherwise it adds one structure field to another field in the same structure.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24C34
name: scale_input_by_constants
description: Divides two inputs by 200, then multiplies each quotient by a constant, 160 for the first and 190 for the second, and packs the two results into one longword.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24C46
name: call_routine_within_range
description: Calls a routine only when a value is non-zero and an input passes range tests against a limit derived from a global. Otherwise it returns early without calling anything.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24C74
name: check_tile_collision_bounds
description: Walks a sequence of tile entries through a table, testing status bits and comparing a computed position against threshold values. It sets a boundary value when a tile passes the test and stops when the entry count runs out.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24D36
name: compute_tile_collision_mask
description: Returns all ones when a value is below one. Otherwise it walks table entries derived from two coordinates and a global stride, ORs the masked contents of each referenced entry together, and returns the combined bits filtered by flags.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24D92
name: scan_object_list_for_match
description: Computes a starting table pointer from two coordinates and calls a routine. It then walks a linked list of object records, comparing each record's position with the given value and calling a routine for records with particular status values, and returns the starting table pointer.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24DCC
name: evaluate_tile_collision
description: Walks a list of tile indices until it reaches a negative entry. Entries 82 and 88 take a value from the global table, while other entries are checked for a flag bit and a position test, and the routine returns early when a flag or bit condition fails. It calls a routine with the computed position at the end.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:24F2A
name: process_object_table_state
description: Iterates an object table, testing per-object state values and tile codes, and dispatches to routines that act on each object. It returns early when a global flag or the object state says to skip. The facts also list the joystick port and display registers as touched, but this description covers only the table logic visible in the code.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:25630
name: call_two_routines_if_clear
description: When one global flag is set and a second global flag is zero, it calls two routines; otherwise it returns without action.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:25672
name: process_event_packet
description: Reads an event code from a pointer and branches on it. For five specific codes it loads a set of table values and calls routines; otherwise it compares a key byte against a character table and either calls a handler stored in a structure or waits on a status bit, then calls a routine to finish.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:258AC
name: loop_until_flag_then_record
description: Calls a routine up to five times. When a register flag is non-zero it records the pass number and two words taken from the stack in globals, then returns.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:25914
name: clear_global_longword_block
description: Writes zero to 25 consecutive longwords of a global block, in five groups of five.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2592A
name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately with no instructions, so it is an empty stub.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2594C
name: poll_values_until_stable
description: Calls two routines, then repeatedly reads a value from a routine four times per pass. When a read value exceeds a reference value, it calls two routines and repeats the pass; when a pass triggers nothing it calls one more routine and returns.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2598E
name: return_word_at_pointer
description: Returns the word stored at the address held in the A3 register.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:259A4
name: store_four_words
description: Writes the four register words D0 to D3 into four consecutive words at the address held in the A3 register.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:259B4
name: replace_zeros_with_minus_one
description: Walks five consecutive longwords at the A3 address and replaces each zero with minus one, leaving other values unchanged.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:259CC
name: clear_minus_one_entries
description: Walks five consecutive longwords at the A3 address and replaces each minus-one value with zero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:259E4
name: check_flag_and_dispatch
description: When one global flag is zero, a bit test passes and a second global is zero, it calls two routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:25A12
name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately with no instructions, so it is an empty stub.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:25A48
name: check_collision_state
description: When a global flag is set, it compares a value against a threshold and sets a state word to one or two. On a match it resets several counters, stores a callback pointer, sets a countdown to 250 and sets a further flag, then calls five routines when a second flag is clear.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:25B02
name: swap_global_word_arrays
description: Swaps 6240 words between two global word arrays, element by element.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:25B1E
name: update_input_state_flags
description: When a global flag is set, it clears several input state flags and runs a cooldown counter that stops at zero, then calls a routine. When that flag is clear it calls routines in sequence and copies two values into global fields when a further flag is set. The facts name a walking input routine among the calls.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:25B9A
name: update_player_motion_state
description: Calls routines that update motion, copies a speed value and an offset from a table, and steps a sequence index through five entries using a countdown of twenty steps, loading a table entry for each step. When the index reaches five it calls a routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:25D2E
name: compare_motion_and_set_state
description: When a motion value is negative or a flag bit is clear, it compares a stored value with another structure's value. When they differ and a flag is clear, it records the new value, clears a flag and sets a state field to two; when the flag is set it stores eight in a timer field. Otherwise it checks a second state flag.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:25DAA
name: reset_fields_and_copy_longword
description: Clears two fields and a flag, sets a state field to two, copies a longword from the source structure, and then subtracts the difference of two fields from a position field when the state field is non-zero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:25EA2
name: update_object_state
description: Calls a routine, subtracts a fixed amount from a longword field of one structure, clears a global flag, sets a field to one and a second field to two, sets another field to four and copies a global longword into a field.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:25ED6
name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately with no instructions, so it is an empty stub.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:25EF8
name: advance_sequence_state_machine
description: Copies two global values into place and clears a flag, then advances a phase counter through several countdown phases. Each phase reloads table values into a state structure and calls a routine, with phase timers set to values such as 200, 3, 7 and 35, and it calls ten routines in total.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26320
name: update_state_if_changed
description: When a flag is clear, it reads one global table value and, if it differs from the stored value, stores the new value and sets a state flag to two.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26372
name: update_stored_value_if_changed
description: Reads a global value, and if it differs from the stored value, stores the new value and sets a state flag to two.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:263A8
name: clear_structure_byte_block
description: Writes zero to 6570 consecutive bytes of a structure, starting at a fixed offset from the A5 base.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:263BA
name: init_linked_structure_block
description: Initializes 200 consecutive 96-byte structures in a block addressed from the A5 base. It stores each structure's pointer in a table, links each structure to the next, zeroes several fields and sets a byte field to minus one.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:263FE
name: fill_pointer_table_stride
description: Fills 120 consecutive longword entries with addresses of a global block, each address 24 bytes after the previous one.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2641C
name: store_derived_object_fields
description: Looks up a structure through a global table indexed by a register and stores two longwords into it. It also writes derived fields: the product of two register inputs, several decremented size fields and a value multiplied by a third input. It increments a global counter.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26478
name: fill_entry_grid_fields
description: Fills a grid of structure entries from a global table. For each entry it stores two longwords and derived size, position and step fields computed from the register inputs, moving across rows and wrapping to the next row after a set count.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26518
name: reset_sprite_position
description: Resets two object structures found through a pointer table. If the index is above 200 it halts in an endless loop. Otherwise it stores position and velocity inputs, zeroes the motion fields, copies a longword from a global array indexed by a register into both objects and clears their flag fields.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:265A0
name: store_inputs_and_decrement_counters
description: Stores two input words into two global variables, then stores two other inputs, each reduced by one, into a pair of global counters.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:265BE
name: calculate_object_velocity
description: Calculates velocity components for two objects found through a pointer table. Each component is the input coordinate minus the object's stored position, and the results are written into its velocity fields.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:265F8
name: add_velocity_to_position
description: Adds two velocity inputs to the position fields of two object structures found through a pointer table indexed by a register value.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26622
name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately with no instructions, so it is an empty stub.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26698
name: clear_object_table_entry
description: Writes zero to a longword field at a fixed offset in two object structures found through a pointer table indexed by a register.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:266BA
name: set_object_state_flags
description: Copies a longword from a global table, indexed by a register, into a field of two object structures found through a pointer table. It then sets a byte field to minus one and a word field to zero in each.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:266FA
name: store_ordered_bounds
description: Orders two value pairs so that the smaller value of each pair comes first, then writes both pairs into a structure found through a pointer table. It masks the first pair's fields and reduces both upper values by one.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26742
name: update_pointer_offset
description: When a register value is non-zero, it calls routines and, if a pointer value is below that register value, stores the register value at an offset of four in two structures, calling two routines between the writes.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26804
name: clip_and_position_display_object
description: Updates one display object: it zeroes a flag field, copies its position and offset fields, and computes a screen position relative to the camera offsets. It clamps the object's area to a visible window, sets visibility fields and calls two routines. The facts show that it calls the display list routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26AE4
name: copy_nonzero_bytes_by_row
description: Sets a source pointer from an object field, then copies non-zero bytes row by row into a buffer. For each copied byte it writes a value into a field of an indexed structure. It then ORs a table of words together and sets flags from the result.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26BAC
name: fill_rect_with_byte
description: Fills a rectangle in a buffer with a byte value taken from a structure field. The width and height come from two fields of the same structure, and a row stride field moves the pointer to the next row.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26BD0
name: clear_rectangular_buffer
description: Writes zero to a rectangle of bytes in a buffer, using its width, height and row stride fields from a structure.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26BF2
name: cull_object_list_to_screen
description: Walks a linked list of object records and calls routines for each. Records whose computed screen position lies inside a window of 321 by 209 are updated and have their status fields reset, and records that fail the test are cleared.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26C88
name: queue_nonzero_rows_for_blit
description: Walks rows of an object's buffer. For each non-zero entry it clears the entry and queues a blitter operation, waiting on the busy flag before writing the pointer and size registers, with values computed from the object's fields.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26C9C
name: queue_row_blits_from_buffer
description: Walks rows of an object's buffer with a stride taken from a global table. For each non-zero entry it clears the entry and programs the blitter, waiting on the busy flag before each set of pointer and size writes.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26D74
name: blit_entries_from_pointer_list
description: Walks a pointer list of entries. For each non-zero byte it clears the byte and programs the blitter, choosing between two destination pointer and size settings depending on whether the byte matches a value in the object record.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26E82
name: blit_pending_rows
description: Clears a pending flag and, when it was set, walks rows of a buffer with nested loops, clearing non-zero bytes and programming the blitter for each run.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26ED6
name: clear_blitter_control_blocks
description: Writes zero to two 16-bit fields in each of eight consecutive 24-byte control blocks in a global block.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26EEE
name: set_blit_control_block
description: Fills one 24-byte blitter control block selected by a register index. It sets a marker field to minus one, stores a pointer, derives two size values by shifting a register input, sets a row stride from a second input and sets a flag value of 128 when a further register is non-zero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26EF4
name: write_blit_control_entry
description: Writes one 24-byte entry at a base pointer, using the same fields as the neighbouring blit control setter: a marker of minus one, a pointer, derived size values, a row stride and a flag value.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26F3C
name: queue_table_entries_in_window
description: Walks a global table of 24-byte entries, reads their positions and sizes, and for entries inside a window of 312 horizontally and 64 to 470 vertically it calls a routine and writes blit pointer and size values into the block list.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26F4E
name: queue_object_list_in_window
description: Walks a list of object entries and, for those inside a window of 312 horizontally and 64 to 470 vertically, calls a routine and writes blit pointer and size values into the block list.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:26FEE
name: shift_in_table_sign_bit
description: Takes the low byte of a word from a global table, selected by a register index, and places its sign bit in the top bit of the result. The rest of the result is the input shifted right by one.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27018
name: store_entry_value_and_count
description: Writes a word into one field of a 24-byte global table entry selected by the data register, and writes a word one greater than a second input into another field of that entry.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2701C
name: store_value_count_at_offset
description: Writes a word at a byte offset given by the data register in a global block, and writes a word one greater than a second input two bytes further on.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27022
name: update_entity_offset_fields
description: Writes a word to a field at a register offset plus 12 within a structure, and stores one more than a second input at a register offset plus 14.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27032
name: clear_entry_word
description: Writes zero to a word field at the start of a 24-byte entry in a global table, selected by the data register.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2703C
name: clear_word_at_offset
description: Writes zero to a word located at the base address held in A0 plus the data register offset.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2704A
name: set_global_word_minus_one
description: Writes an all-ones word at a global offset given by the data register.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:27050
name: write_minus_one_at_offset
description: Writes an all-ones word at the base address in A0 plus the data register offset.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2705A
name: update_entry_value_and_size
description: Stores a longword into a 24-byte entry selected by the data register. When a second input is non-negative and differs from the stored value, it updates that value and sets a size field to the new value plus one, times a stored size, times two.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2705E
name: update_value_size_at_offset
description: Stores a longword and, when a second input is non-negative and changed, updates a value field and a size field at a byte offset given by the data register.
